```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(wesanderson)
library(stringr)
library(officer)

options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)

save_figure <- function(navn, width=12, height=8, figure_folder=figure_folder){
  ggsave(paste0(figure_folder, navn, ".png"), dpi=600, dev='png', units="cm", width = width, height = height)
}
```

```{r Constants}
Sys.getlocale()
Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL", "no_NB.utf8")

wf <- paste0(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path), "/")
wf
```

# Pricing experiment surveys
Data: https://zenodo.org/records/8248802
```{r}
load(paste0(wf,"Data/iFlex dataset.RData"))
```

## Survey 1
```{r}
df_info <- data.frame(ColumnName = names(survey1_answers), ColumnType = sapply(survey1_answers, class))

N <- nrow(survey1_answers)
paste("N =", N)

# Create word document
doc <- read_docx()

fig_folder <- paste0(wf, "Survey1/")

# Assuming that columns starting with 'q' are questions
answers <- survey1_answers[,2:ncol(survey1_answers)]
for (i in 1:ncol(answers)) { #ncol(answers)
  print(paste(i, colnames(answers)[i], class(answers[[i]])))
  question_id <- colnames(answers)[i]
  question_name <- paste("Question", question_id)
  title_text <- paste0(question_name, ": ", survey1_questions$Question[survey1_questions$Question_ID == question_id][1])
  #title_text <- str_wrap(title_text, width = 70)
  
  fig_name <- paste0("Question", i, "_", question_id)
  
  
  # Create a temporary data frame for each question
  temp_df <- answers[,i]
  colnames(temp_df) <- "Answers"
  temp_df <- filter(temp_df, !(is.na(Answers)))
  N <- nrow(temp_df)
 

  # Create the plot
  if (class(temp_df$Answers) == "numeric"){
    alternatives <- unique(temp_df$Answers)

    temp_df <- temp_df %>% 
      group_by(Answers) %>% 
      summarise(n = n()/N, .groups = 'drop')
    print(temp_df)
    
    p <- ggplot(temp_df, aes(x = Answers, y = n)) +
      geom_col(fill=wes_palette("Zissou1")[1]) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color="black"), 
           axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
           plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
           plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0),
           panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey", linewidth = 0.1)) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + 
      labs(subtitle = paste0("(n=", N, ")"), x="", y="")
    
    fig_height <- 6
    if (length(alternatives)<=10){
      fig_width <- 13
      save_figure(navn=fig_name, figure_folder = fig_folder, height = fig_height, width = fig_width)
    } else {
      fig_width <- 16
      save_figure(navn=fig_name, figure_folder = fig_folder, height = fig_height, width = fig_width)     
    }

    
  } else {
    alternatives <- survey1_questions$Answer[survey1_questions$Question_ID == colnames(answers)[i]]
    alternatives <- str_wrap(alternatives, 50)
    alternatives <- str_pad(alternatives, width = 50, side = "left")
    
    temp_df <- temp_df %>% 
      group_by(Answers) %>% 
      summarise(n = round(n()/N * 100), .groups = 'drop')
    temp_df$Answers <- str_wrap(temp_df$Answers, 50)
    temp_df$Answers <- str_pad(temp_df$Answers, width = 50, side = "left")
    temp_df$Answers <- factor(temp_df$Answers, levels=rev(alternatives))
    temp_df$Answers <- fct_na_value_to_level(temp_df$Answers, level = "No answer")
    print(temp_df)
  
    p <- ggplot(temp_df, aes(x = Answers, y = n)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill=wes_palette("Zissou1")[1]) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, max(temp_df$n) * 1.2)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "%")), hjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank()) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color="black"), 
          axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0)) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1), 
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x = element_blank()) +
    labs(subtitle = paste0("(n=", N, ")"), x="") +
    coord_flip()
    
    print(p)
    fig_height <- length(alternatives) + 2
    fig_width <- 16
    save_figure(navn=fig_name, figure_folder = fig_folder, height = fig_height, width = fig_width)
  }
  
  # Add to word document
  doc <- doc %>% 
    body_add_par("") %>%
    body_add_par(title_text) %>%
    body_add_img(src = paste0(fig_folder, fig_name, ".png"), width = fig_width * 0.3937007874, height = fig_height * 0.3937007874) # Have to convert from cm to inches
}

print(doc, target = paste0(fig_folder, "Survey1 figures.docx"))
```

## Survey 3
Answers have to be divided into experiment participants and general population.
```{r}
ids_exp <- participants$ID[participants$Participation_Experiment == "Yes" & participants$Survey3_answered == "Yes"]

ids_pop <- participants$ID[participants$Participation_Experiment == "No" & participants$Survey3_answered == "Yes"]

survey3_answers_exp <- filter(survey3_answers, ID %in% ids_exp)
survey3_answers_pop <- filter(survey3_answers, ID %in% ids_pop)
```

# Real world survey
Data: https://zenodo.org/records/8423312
```{r}
survey_questions <- read_csv(paste0(wf,"Data/survey.csv"))
survey_answers <- read_csv(paste0(wf,"Data/answers.csv"))

# Replace the numbers in survey_answers with the corresponding text
# Loop over all columns in survey_answers
for (colname in colnames(survey_answers)) {
  # Check if the column exists in survey_questions
  if (colname %in% survey_questions$Question_ID) {
    # Check if is multiple choice or numeric
    if (survey_questions$Option_translation[survey_questions$Question_ID == colname][1] != "Numeric value") {
      df_options <- survey_questions[survey_questions$Question_ID == colname, c("Option_number", "Option_translation")]
      df_options$Option_number <- as.numeric(df_options$Option_number)
      df_temp <- survey_answers[ ,colname]
      colnames(df_temp) <- "Option_number"
      df_temp <- df_temp %>% left_join(df_options, by = "Option_number")
      survey_answers[ ,colname] <- df_temp[, "Option_translation"]
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
df_info <- data.frame(ColumnName = names(survey_answers), ColumnType = sapply(survey_answers, class))

# Assuming that columns starting with 'Q' are questions
answers <- survey_answers[,2:ncol(survey_answers)]
for (i in 1:ncol(answers)) {
  print(paste(i, colnames(answers)[i], class(answers[[i]])))
  question_id <- colnames(answers)[i]
  question_name <- paste("Question", question_id)
  title_text <- paste0(question_name, ": ", survey_questions$Question_translation[survey_questions$Question_ID == question_id][1])
  #title_text <- str_wrap(title_text, width = 70)
  
  fig_name <- paste0("Question", i, "_", question_id)

  # Create a temporary data frame for each question
  temp_df <- answers[,i]
  colnames(temp_df) <- "Answers"
  temp_df <- filter(temp_df, !(is.na(Answers)))
  N <- nrow(temp_df)
 

  # Create the plot
  if (class(temp_df$Answers) == "numeric"){
    alternatives <- unique(temp_df$Answers)

    temp_df <- temp_df %>% 
      group_by(Answers) %>% 
      summarise(n = n()/N, .groups = 'drop')
    print(temp_df)
    
    p <- ggplot(temp_df, aes(x = Answers, y = n)) +
      geom_col(fill=wes_palette("Zissou1")[1]) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color="black"), 
           axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
           plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
           plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0),
           panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey", linewidth = 0.1)) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + 
      labs(subtitle = paste0("(n=", N, ")"), x="", y="")
    
    fig_height <- 6
    if (length(alternatives)<=10){
      fig_width <- 13
      save_figure(navn=fig_name, figure_folder = fig_folder, height = fig_height, width = fig_width)
    } else {
      fig_width <- 16
      save_figure(navn=fig_name, figure_folder = fig_folder, height = fig_height, width = fig_width)     
    }

    
  } else {
    alternatives <- survey_questions$Option_translation[survey_questions$Question_ID == colnames(answers)[i]]
    alternatives <- str_wrap(alternatives, 50)
    alternatives <- str_pad(alternatives, width = 50, side = "left")
    
    temp_df <- temp_df %>% 
      group_by(Answers) %>% 
      summarise(n = round(n()/N * 100), .groups = 'drop')
    temp_df$Answers <- str_wrap(temp_df$Answers, 50)
    temp_df$Answers <- str_pad(temp_df$Answers, width = 50, side = "left")
    temp_df$Answers <- factor(temp_df$Answers, levels=rev(alternatives))
    temp_df$Answers <- fct_na_value_to_level(temp_df$Answers, level = "No answer")
    print(temp_df)
  
    p <- ggplot(temp_df, aes(x = Answers, y = n)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill=wes_palette("Zissou1")[1]) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, max(temp_df$n) * 1.2)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "%")), hjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank()) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color="black"), 
          axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0)) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1), 
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x = element_blank()) +
    labs(subtitle = paste0("(n=", N, ")"), x="") +
    coord_flip()
    
    print(p)
    fig_height <- length(alternatives) + 2
    fig_width <- 16
    save_figure(navn=fig_name, figure_folder = fig_folder, height = fig_height, width = fig_width)
  }
  
  # Add to word document
  doc <- doc %>% 
    body_add_par("") %>%
    body_add_par(title_text) %>%
    body_add_img(src = paste0(fig_folder, fig_name, ".png"), width = fig_width * 0.3937007874, height = fig_height * 0.3937007874) # Have to convert from cm to inches
}

print(doc, target = paste0(fig_folder, "Survey_real figures.docx"))
```
